scope: Independent pre-outcome conceptual and executable design review
review_status: Approved exact executable design before scientific outcomes
question: What can redshift, intrinsic broadening and local continuum curvature change under the reviewed original-native point-resolution RATE v3 likelihood?
heldout_training_cases: Baseline and width1000, each trained on two of three official RATE groups; independent group continuum profiled when predicting the third
dependencies: Reviewed RATE noise version 3, gain-corrected full-row signed donor operator and fresh empirical control transport
Fixed Te20000K/ne1000cm-3 physical multiplet cell and original-native generic-point curve
Existing masks, extraction geometry and source covariance; no independent calibration prior inferred from these same spectra
expected_information: Transport previously tested width/continuum sensitivities onto the corrected physical donor-noise and signed full-row response rather than repeat the old scenario grid
Compare specified alternatives by conditional flux/covariance and held-out pixel predictions
Demonstrate source-width versus instrumental Gaussian LSF and redshift versus common fractional centroid-error nonidentifiability
required_conventions: v is intrinsic FWHM in km/s; R_eff^-2=R^-2+(v/c)^2 then applies to Gaussian FWHM quadrature
The first derivative with respect to v at zero is zero: use u=v^2 or label width changes finite contrasts rather than regular Fisher derivatives
An exact redshift/calibration claim must define the centroid convention; complete wavelength-grid dilation also changes bin widths, Fnu units and LSF sampling
Projected whitened sensitivity evaluated with fitted amplitudes is a plug-in local diagnostic, not calibrated power or a confidence bound
The published redshift range comes from the same source analysis and supplies a sensitivity range, not an independent prior
No scenario counts or best members are probabilities; unknown source LSF and common wavelength systematics remain uncalibrated
Projected singular values and SNR depend on the declared contrast scaling, including the unit quadratic-continuum coefficient; they are not an invariant Fisher analysis
stopping: Stop after the six fixed full cases, six held-out training cases and declared algebraic diagnostics, or earlier on identity/operator/runtime failure; do not expand the scan based on outcomes
author_proposal_provenance: Spectroscopy agent pre-outcome proposal delivered before code/results freeze; parent requested independent design review
